song.title: Times Are Coming
song.description: The weather is turning colder, but something good is coming. A sweet, inspiring dubstep song, mixed then mastered in generative.download — the DAW I built.

lyrics.text:
[Verse 1]
Times are coming.
It's not quite how the wind turns.
Stuck in this van,
But we're finding our way.
How've you been?
I'm doing better today.
[Pre-Build]
Times are coming!
Times are coming!
We can make it through.
Times are coming!
Times are coming!
Something good is breaking through.
[Drop]
It's coming! It's coming!
Something good is coming!
It's coming! It's coming!
We are moving through!
[Bridge]
The road bends wide,
The rain lets go.
You take my hand,
And we both know.
[Pre-Build]
Times are coming!
Times are coming!
We can make it through.
Times are coming!
Times are coming!
Something good is breaking through.
[Final Drop]
It's coming! It's coming!
Something good is coming!
It's coming! It's coming!
We are moving through!
[Final Drop]
It's coming! It's coming!
Something good is coming!
It's coming! It's coming!
We are moving through!
[Outro]
Times are coming.
Something good is coming.
